title: A download that skips files already on disk must still count and use them
rule: When a write into a user folder skips files that are already there (never overwrite), the caller must treat the skipped files as present: scan or index them, activate or report them, and check the disk before any network request so they are not fetched again. Do not drive the next step from the 'written' list alone. Test with the target files on disk but not in the library (a removed source, an earlier manual copy): assert no request, the faces active and nothing written.
rationale: E22.7 (#427): install_family matched faces only against the files the download wrote; with the family already in the folder but not indexed, every file was fetched, skipped, and nothing was activated ("0 styles active").
